test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3' **i.e. **'All over'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"bullets were flying"** suggests a chaotic and intense situation.
 
• By saying "bullets were flying all over,"** it emphasizes **that the bullets were scattered or coming from various directions.
 
• **It conveys **the sense of a widespread and uncontrolled gunfire.
 
• This** phrase effectively describes** the intensity and danger of the situation.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *There were two **childhood** buddies who went through school and college and even joined the army together. War **broke out **and they were **fighting** in the same unit. One night they were ambushed. Bullets were flying **all over** and out of the darkness came a voice, “Harry, please come and help me”. Harry (5)________recognised that voice of his childhood buddy*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "up and over,"** does not accurately convey the scattered or widespread nature of the bullets. It implies movement rather than dispersion.
 
• **Option 2, "above,"** is not specific enough to capture the idea of bullets flying from different directions.
 
• **Option 4, "over," **is a more general term and does not convey the sense of bullets being scattered or coming from multiple directions.
